facts.title: VFX-JS - Visual Effects Framework for Web #VFXJS
facts.description: VFX-JS is a JavaScript library to add WebGL powered effects to your website.

research.name: VFX-JS
research.note: JavaScript library that attaches WebGL shader effects such as glitch, RGB shift and halftone to ordinary img, video, canvas and div elements.

effects: WebGL post-effects attached to plain DOM elements (img, video, GIF, canvas, experimental live div with inputs)
Preset shaders such as glitch with overflow beyond the element, rgbShift, rainbow, halftone and duotone
Viewport-triggered transition shaders: slitScanTransition, warpTransition, pixelateTransition, focusTransition

unverified: The component source is in the public repository fand/vfx-js (MIT, 1158 stars); this site research has not yet been redone as a repository research of fand/vfx-js.
